scope.description: Asynchronous local storage completion across leader-context changes with an accepted replacement not yet reflected in Storage.
assumptions: Reliable FIFO append requests and FIFO local responses; remote responses delivered only after their writes.
Protocol messages produced by actual raft nodes; caller initializes a valid shared committed prefix.
No crash, snapshot, compaction or configuration activation during the selected preservation interval.
excluded: General election safety or committed-entry agreement across nodes

parameters.faults: finite network loss and response/write delays

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Substitute MemoryStorage for durable device I/O under a no-crash model.
Use a deterministic network scheduler with finite message loss and independent response recipient delays.
Read private logical log and unstable state for observations; no target code or dependencies are replaced.
Canonicalize actual entry contents as JSON strings for scalar comparison; this is reversible serialization, not hashing.

plan_uncertainties: Bounded single producer history; no universal safety or crash-durability conclusion.
The final permitted completion and drain are diagnostics, not additional independent properties or consensus agreement evidence.

boundaries: General election safety or committed-entry agreement across nodes
